# Sibling checkouts CI places beside this repository, each at ONE pinned commit, by
# .github/scripts/siblings.sh, which refuses an unpinned name, a short or symbolic commit and a
# URL outside https://github.com/urnetwork/. Bump a pin in its own commit.
# name  url  commit
#
# connect: the transport. The SDK module (sdk/go.mod), the native composition (sdk/cgo/go.mod) and
# the two command modules build against it, and protocol.yml reads its frame.proto as text. Pinned
# to the HEAD OF THE CONNECT PULL REQUEST THAT REMOVES MESSAGING from connect and adds
# connect.NewOperatorClientSettings, which sdk/message_tunnel.go calls. A connect still carrying
# message.proto would register the schema twice in every binary here, which protobuf refuses at
# init. PLACEHOLDER until that pull request's head is filled in: siblings.sh refuses it, so every
# job that needs connect fails until it is.
connect https://github.com/urnetwork/connect.git FILL_IN_THE_CONNECT_REMOVAL_PR_HEAD_SHA
#
# sdk: the core SDK. native.yml lays its cgo package main under sdk/cgo to build the one native
# library both halves ship in. Pinned to the HEAD OF THE SDK PULL REQUEST THAT REMOVES MESSAGING
# from the core SDK; sdk/cgo/compose.sh refuses a core that still carries the messaging half.
# PLACEHOLDER, as above.
sdk https://github.com/urnetwork/sdk.git FILL_IN_THE_SDK_REMOVAL_PR_HEAD_SHA
#
# connect-golden: urnetwork/connect from BEFORE the messaging schema left it (the merge of #217,
# 2026-10-05 09:10Z; protocol/message.pb.go is the copy this repository's was regenerated from).
# protocol.yml's wire-golden job emits the corpus from it with -tags orig. It stays pinned there:
# it is the byte-equality check's reference, not a build dependency.
connect-golden https://github.com/urnetwork/connect.git 92a657fadab90293b86703dd0c333b95595cffe9
#
# glog, gvisor and goidenticons: what connect and the core SDK replace by path, which their own
# go.mod files cannot do for this repository's modules. gvisor's commit is on urnetwork/gvisor's
# default branch, go.
glog https://github.com/urnetwork/glog.git 80a11b434ae90ae2221deb932daa21913919875a
gvisor https://github.com/urnetwork/gvisor.git c0783dba2eeff7b79692a7f122ffee5f8bd837c1
goidenticons https://github.com/urnetwork/goidenticons.git 06eb779a691e056be7dc5fa9a0239001c3ea390f
